dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible perimeters of 3-5 irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp pixel intensity transitions from low-intensity (dark) exteriors to high-intensity (light-gray) rims. The perimeters have non-uniform thickness and jagged edges, surrounding low-intensity centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, asymmetrical, solid light-gray pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These are distributed primarily in the interstitial spaces between the larger macro-annuli and across the lower lateral flanks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal surface form a scalene triangle. A separate cluster of four high-intensity blobs on the anterior lateral region forms an irregular quadrilateral geometric relationship.
